features:
Key Features:

Made with whole grain oats and a creamy almond butter filling.

Each sandwich provides 14 grams of whole grains.

No artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Convenient individually wrapped pouches, great for on-the-go snacking.

Benefits:

Portable and convenient: Ideal for breakfast, snacks, or packed lunches.

Satisfying combo: Crunchy biscuits and nut butter give a satisfying bite and good energy.

Balanced macros: Provides a mix of carbs, fat, and a touch of protein and fiber.

Cleaner label: Free from many artificial ingredients found in traditional snack bars.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Almond Butter (almonds), Canola Oil, Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Whole Grain Barley Flakes, Cinnamon, Corn Starch, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor.
